title: Associated primes of a nonzero principal quotient of a normal Noetherian domain
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian normal integral domain [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring], and let $a\in A$ be nonzero. An associated prime of $A/aA$ means a prime ideal equal to the annihilator $\{r\in A: r\bar c=0\}$ of some nonzero $\bar c\in A/aA$. Every such associated prime $\mathfrak p$ has height one: $(0)\subsetneq\mathfrak p$, and there is no strict chain of prime ideals of length greater than one ending at $\mathfrak p$ [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring].
